entities.name: Jijeung of Silla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jijeung (437–514) was the 22nd ruler and 1st king of the Koreanic kingdom Silla. He is remembered for strengthening royal authority and building Silla into a centralized kingdom. On the contemporary Naengsuri Silla monument, his name was inscribed as Jidoro.
